data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 491.854m. Using the gross claims development table, the syndicate records a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 3.14m (a release), driven by mixed movements across older underwriting years (notably releases in several years offset by some strengthenings). The published movement note reports a net favourable development of GBP 14.6m net of reinsurance recoveries, comprising releases in Third Party Liability and Reinsurance acceptances and a small strengthening across other classes.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior year's provision' note in the accounts only reports a NET of reinsurance figure (GBP 14.6m favourable). A gross PYD figure was not provided in that note. I therefore computed a gross prior-year development from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates) which yields a net release of approximately GBP 3.14m. The triangle excludes the aggregated '2010 & prior' column from calculations as required. No RITC was identified. Net and gross figures differ materially (net favourable GBP 14.6m vs gross favourable ~GBP 3.14m) because reinsurance recoveries materially affected the net outcome.
